capabilities: Suppress native spellcheck outside the paragraph under the caret
Toggle paragraph spelling focus with a command or settings control
Highlight the active focus range with an optional background
Scope spellcheck to the enclosing heading section (Pro)
Apply per-folder scope rules for paragraph, section, or off (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a spelling engine or dictionary tool; it only suppresses Obsidian's native spellcheck outside the focused range.
extras: Freemium: paragraph focus is free; section scope and folder rules require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment and GitHub device-flow sign-in. Desktop only. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). No network requests until sign-in; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: The plugin uses the spelling service that Obsidian already provides.
problem: Native spellcheck underlines unknown words across the whole note, which distracts writers editing one passage while names and terms elsewhere get marked.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike for Pro features

summary: Spellcheck scoping plugin that limits Obsidian's native spellcheck to the paragraph under the caret, with optional section scope and folder rules.
